## Verdict

Heronry costs least for a team of 45, at $405 per month. Its 10-seat minimum sits well below the team size, so all 45 seats bill at the $9 list rate with no padding. Juno Board is next at $675, and Cygnus Flow is dearest at $945.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Juno Board | $15 | 40 |
| Cygnus Flow | $21 | 1 |
| Heronry | $9 | 10 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the team size (45) or the vendor minimum, whichever is larger. All three minimums fall below 45, so every vendor bills exactly 45 seats.

- **Heronry:** 45 × $9 = **$405 per month**
- **Juno Board:** 45 × $15 = **$675 per month**
- **Cygnus Flow:** 45 × $21 = **$945 per month**

Heronry is $270 per month cheaper than Juno Board and $540 cheaper than Cygnus Flow — $3,240 and $6,480 over twelve months. The spread between cheapest and dearest is $540 per month, or 133% of Heronry's total bill.

## Risks

No minimum binds at this headcount, so the ranking is a straight comparison of per-seat rates and holds at any size above 40. Below 40, Juno Board's floor starts to bite: at 30 people it still bills $600, an effective $20 per person against Heronry's $9. Cygnus Flow's 1-seat minimum makes it the most flexible on headcount and the most expensive at every size on this list.

The price list gives per-seat rates and minimums and nothing else. Feature coverage, support tiers, security posture, usage limits and integrations are unknown, so this says which vendor is cheapest, not which is the better buy.

All figures assume monthly billing at list price as stated. Annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees and migration costs are not in the source and could reorder these totals.
